text: ECharts formatters get epoch ms: format with formatInTimeZone(ts, tz, fmt). new Date(ts).toLocale* uses the browser zone and is wrong here.
Time unit tests: npx vitest run src/lib/time. DST cases pin the clock with vi.setSystemTime; vitest.config.ts forces TZ=UTC.
E2E: npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/timezone.spec.ts; Playwright expects the mock API (npm run mock) on :8787.
Charts always render in the site's own timezone (site.tz from the API); users can't pick a different one.
Chart timezone is the user preference if set, else site.tz; read it from effectiveTz in src/lib/time/zones.ts, not from the store directly.
Timezone and other user preferences live only in localStorage via a hand-rolled writable; nothing syncs to the server.
Preferences sync to /api/me/preferences (1s debounce) and localStorage is just a cache; add new keys to the PreferencesSchema zod type.
Use Node 18 (nvm use 18) for this repo.
Node 22 LTS is required (.nvmrc); Node 18 breaks since the Vite 6 upgrade.
moment-timezone was removed for bundle size; use date-fns-tz. ESLint no-restricted-imports blocks moment imports.
Safari before 15.4 lacks Intl.supportedValuesOf; keep the static IANA list as the picker's fallback.
Offsets aren't always whole hours (Asia/Kolkata +5:30, Asia/Kathmandu +5:45); bucketing code must not assume 60-minute steps.
src/routes/(app)/billing/+page.server.ts loads invoices server-side only; never move it to a universal +page.ts (it uses an API key).
Site list search is fuzzy (fuse.js, threshold 0.3); tune it in src/lib/search.ts.
Alert thresholds in src/lib/components/alerts/ThresholdForm.svelte are re-validated by the API; client checks are UX only.
The live readings websocket (src/lib/live/socket.ts) reconnects with jittered backoff capped at 30s.
CSV export is streamed by the API; the frontend only builds the download URL.
Auth is cookie-based in hooks.server.ts; locals.user is typed in src/app.d.ts.
Conventional Commits with scopes charts, prefs, ui, time, api; release-please writes the changelog.
Before a PR: npm run lint (eslint + prettier --check) and npm run check (svelte-check) must both pass.
Setup: npm ci, cp .env.example .env, npm run dev; start the mock API with npm run mock.
New components use Svelte 5 runes ($state, $derived, $props); no legacy $: statements.
main auto-deploys to staging on Cloudflare Pages; production is a manual promote in the dashboard.
Component tests mount with @testing-library/svelte; wrap anything reading the preferences store in withPreferences() from tests/helpers.ts.
